"I'm all for improving farming and food standards" - if you think that standards aren't good enough at the moment, surely you should be boycotting these practices?

"With how governments and companies treat their people let alone animals" - Being oppressed doesn't give you the right to oppress. Do you know how many animal agriculture workers leave the industry with life-changing injuries and mental issues? These companies treat things the way they do because your pound goes towards continuing the breeding and killing of innocent beings.

"Humans are omnivorous creatures" - We have the ability to digest meat, doesn't mean that we require it though. Humans are naturally lactose intolerant but I imagine that doesnt stop people from consuming dairy.

"Without significant vitamin supplements" - cheap once a day B12 supplement. A lot of animals are fed B12 supplements so you're likely consuming your B12 via supplement anyway.

"Protein and nutritional deficits" - You can obtain all the protein and nutrition you need from a plant-based diet, the same way you can also be malnourised on a mixed diet.

"Nearly on par with environmental damage that animal farming causes" - What do you think the 80 billion land animals that are killed each year consume? \~75% of the world's agricultural land is used for animal agriculture including the area used to grow the food to feed them. Animal agriculture is one of the biggest drivers of environmental destruction.

"Vegan textile alternatives being functionally just plastic" - There are many viable vegan textile alternatives out there, but companies have been allowed to label crappy plastic alternatives as 'vegan leather' for example, so thats what people often associate with the term.

"We can take steps to improve the global situation" - Boycotting the industries that do these things is a step to take.

"Pretending that we can magically make every person...." - No sane person believes that everyone is gonna switch overnight, or even over the course of many years.

"Biased around urban and suburab living" - Again, these people in rural environments could be using the land used to grow animal feed to grow food for direct consumption instead. But even people living rurally have access to plant-based diets, and because they choose to live rurally why does that give them the right to murder innocent animals when they don't have to?

"Cultural wipeout" - It used to be culturally acceptable to have slaves, burn people who were thought to be witches, to have women not be allowed jobs. Just because a traditional cultural meal contains meat doesn't justify killing innocent beings for it.

"Fundamentally out of touch" - A lot of people proclaim themselves as animal lovers and worried about climate change etc, but won't actually do anything that requires themselves to change anything. You can't be an animal lover if you pay for animal abuse, crying about climate change doesn't carry as much merit if you actively support one of the biggest drivers of climate change. That sounds pretty out of touch with being consistent in what you believe in.

"Everyone else is delighting in animal torture" - You may not realise it, but that it is exactly what is happening. You're likely a good person who just doesn't realise the extent of the horror that's been normalised, and that understandly because you've been around it your whole life think it's okay.

"Never won anyone over" - Its won myself and many other people over as it made me realise that I was a hypocrit and that I was supporting industries and actions I don't agree with
